pr_title: AtlasEngine: Fix support for font features
pr_body:
Font features require us to skip the fast path via `GetTextComplexity`.
`IDWriteTextLayout` handles it the same way internally.

Closes #15896

## Validation Steps Performed
* Use Cascadia Code
* Set `features: { "ss19": 1 }`
* "0" has a dash in it instead of a dot ✅

issue_context.title: Atlas engine does not render stylistic sets
issue_context.body:
### Windows Terminal version

1.18.1462.0

### Windows build number

10.0.22621.0

### Other Software

None

### Steps to reproduce

- Set the font to "Cascadia Mono"
- Open the JSON settings and add in the appropriate place `features: { "ss19": 1 }` (see Cascadia Code repo)
- This should choose the slashed zero variant of Cascadia Code
- In the Rendering settings, turn off use Atlas engine
- Slashed 0 is shown in terminal text
- Now turn on Atlas engine
- Slashed 0 is not shown

### Expected Behavior

Atlas engine should render stylistic sets

### Actual Behavior

Atlas engine does not render stylistic sets
comments: Oh, you may need to restart terminal between switching Atlas engine settings
